dataset_name: Sidewalk robot engineering catalogue - expanded, illustrative, unreviewed

records.title: Illustrative project assumption
records.description: Training assumption only: loss of sensing or communications may require a controlled stop. This is not a validated robot capability or approved safety requirement.

records.title: Software watchdog state transition

records.title: NHTSA automated vehicle safety - contextual reading
records.description: NHTSA provides automated-driving safety guidance and describes the importance of testing and validation. Road-vehicle material is contextual reading, not an approved requirement for sidewalk delivery robots.
records.source: https://www.nhtsa.gov/vehicle-safety/automated-vehicle-safety | consulted 2026-10-18; scope: road vehicles, not a sidewalk robot safety approval.

records.title: OSHA robotics overview - contextual reading
records.description: OSHA describes robotics in occupational settings. This source is contextual reading for a hazard-review process, not evidence that a proposed sidewalk-robot mitigation is effective.
records.source: https://www.osha.gov/robotics | consulted 2026-10-18; scope: occupational robotics, not sidewalk deployment approval.

records.title: Severity classification review checklist
records.description: Illustrative checklist: identify the potential harm and exposed population; record supporting project evidence and uncertainty before a human assigns severity. No severity category is preapproved.

records.title: Likelihood and exposure review checklist
records.description: Illustrative checklist: distinguish occurrence data, exposure assumptions and uncertainty. Do not infer likelihood from a compelling AI narrative. Collect reviewed project data before a human assigns likelihood.
